phrase.zh: 平常事物，也有深长回声。

visual.zh: 右侧水罐与展开苞叶的玉米立在铺布的台沿上，罐口可见水面；左侧山谷层层伸远，细刻线区分罐身、籽粒、布纹与山脊。
visual.en: A water jug and partially husked maize stand on a cloth-covered ledge at right, with water visible at the lip; layered valleys recede leftward, etched lines distinguishing clay, kernels, fabric and ridges.

background.zh:
米斯特拉尔的抒情诗关注情感、自然与日常事物。她的《塔拉》写到面包、盐、玉米和水等生活主题。她获得1945年诺贝尔文学奖。画面把水罐、玉米与远处山谷并置，表达日常事物里的诗意，是原创寓意，不是诗集插图、故乡实景或诗句引用。短句为原创。
1945年文学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：以强烈情感推动的抒情诗，使她的名字成为整个拉丁美洲理想追求的象征
background.en:
Mistral’s lyric poetry explores emotion, nature and ordinary things. Her collection Tala includes everyday themes such as bread, salt, maize and water. She received the 1945 Nobel Prize in Literature. A water jug, maize and a distant valley express poetry in daily life through an original metaphor, not a book illustration, an exact place or a quoted verse. The phrase is original.
1945 — The Nobel Prize in Literature. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for her lyric poetry which, inspired by powerful emotions, has made her name a symbol of the idealistic aspirations of the entire Latin American world
